description: This file defines extension methods for ILifecycleParticipant to facilitate participation in lifecycle observables within the Orleans runtime framework. It includes a method to adapt participants to specific lifecycle types and an internal class to bridge different lifecycle participant types.

classes.name: LifecycleParticipantExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for ILifecycleParticipant to support participation in specific lifecycle observables.

classes.name: Bridge
classes.description: A private class that adapts an ILifecycleParticipant<ILifecycleObservable> to an ILifecycleParticipant<TLifecycle> for a specific lifecycle type.

methods.name: ParticipateIn
methods.description: Converts a generic ILifecycleParticipant<ILifecycleObservable> into a specific ILifecycleParticipant<TLifecycle> to participate in a particular lifecycle.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method implementation in Bridge class that delegates participation to the wrapped ILifecycleParticipant.
